profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer | Using software and systems to help technical teams move faster.
profile.summary:
I build enterprise front-end platforms. I specialize in React and TypeScript architecture across large-scale codebases. I lead front-end delivery for Fortune 500 client portals serving millions of users. I own design system integration and theming strategy across multi-developer teams. I serve as the technical escalation point for architectural decisions and represent engineering to clients and stakeholders.  


Key achievements: 
- Serving as the front-end owner for enterprise portals supporting 4M+ users   
- Reduced CI pipeline time by 50% via monorepo tooling migration  
- Built modular theming architecture reducing client customization from 1 week → 1 day     

Let's build your next great platform together.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
EIS delivers enterprise insurance platforms used by global carriers. As a Senior Software Engineer, I lead technical execution for customer-facing portal platforms serving millions of policyholders and operational users.

• Serve as primary technical owner and escalation point across multiple Fortune 500 client implementations, including MassMutual, Pacific Life, and BNP Paribas Cardif.
• Lead end-to-end frontend architecture and delivery for a persona based portals platform supporting 4M+ end users.
• Drive cross-team initiatives integrating Auth0 (OAuth/SSO) and JPMorgan payment processing to enable secure, compliant digital transactions.
• Provide architectural guidance and code oversight to SI partner teams (PwC), improving delivery quality and platform alignment.
• Coordinate execution across product, platform, and client delivery workstreams within a scaled Agile model.

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the architecture and delivery of enterprise insurance portals within a large, distributed Agile environment.

• Led a major portals platform upgrade and migration, reducing CI pipeline time by 50% through a complex migration from Yarn to pnpm and improving forward compatibility across client deployments.
• Designed and implemented a modular theming architecture by abstracting client styling into a dedicated theme entry point, enabling per-client customization and reducing theming effort from ~1 week to ~1 day.
• Closed design-to-development gaps by aligning Figma, Storybook, and engineering workflows into a unified UI source of truth.
• Delivered 50+ production features by tailoring a shared enterprise platform to client-specific requirements using TypeScript and REST/GraphQL APIs.

positions.title: Director of Operations
positions.description:
Technical lead within a high-growth education technology startup, overseeing architecture and delivery across client software initiatives.

• Led engineering execution for a 20+ developer organization, defining architecture, standards, and delivery processes.
• Scoped and sequenced technical initiatives across 4 concurrent client projects, balancing velocity with delivery risk.
• Mentored developers across React, Node.js, WordPress, and CMS integrations in a fast-scaling environment.
• Partnered with executive leadership on delivery strategy, contributing to ~300% revenue growth through repeatable engagement models.
• Established Agile delivery practices and technical governance to support multi-project scale.

positions.title: Lead Technical Instructor
positions.description:
Hybrid engineering and instructional role focused on developing junior software talent while scaling technical education delivery.

• Trained and mentored 40+ developers in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js).
• Designed project-based curriculum covering Git workflows, Agile practices, debugging, and production development standards.
• Led a team of 5 instructors, ensuring instructional consistency and technical quality across cohorts.
• Helped scale the program from 1 to 3 statewide locations by standardizing curriculum and onboarding instructors.
• Prepared graduates for entry-level engineering roles through hands-on, team-based software delivery.
